description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class 'ThingDefinitionNotAccessibleException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models an exception thrown when a Thing's definition is either missing or inaccessible due to permissions, including builder methods and JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A specialized runtime exception indicating that a Thing's definition could not be accessed or was not found due to lack of permissions.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a 'ThingDefinitionNotAccessibleException' with a specific Thing ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a simple message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers, parsing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with updated Ditto headers.
